whatsappMessage:
Hi Gamesworld,

I noticed your gaming store has strong 4.2★ reviews with over 500 happy customers on West Boring Canal Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new console and game inquiries.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp game booking, stock inquiry, aur store timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gamesworld

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
"Hi Gamesworld team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha."
"Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?"
"Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp stock inquiry, mobile-first speed, and showcasing your gaming consoles right on West Boring Canal Road in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
"Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact inventory, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
